params.body:
## What

- The enrich backfill only picks signals that enrich never read (`enrich_model IS NULL`, and not already marked). Before, a signal that enrich read and found no concept in was promoted without one and became a candidate again the next night.
- `--progress` also says what the backfill bought: of the marked signals, how many carry a concept that a live pattern names, and how many an insight cites.
- `enrich_model` gets its migration. `markEnriched` writes it, but only the box's database had the column (from an older migration), so on a fresh database the first enriched signal failed.

## Why

The nightly job sends 500 a night while a count stays above zero. On the box the count went from 5,259 to 5,268 between two batches: signals enriched without a concept, promoted since #313, counted as never enriched. They would be re-enriched every night at full price, for the same empty answer, and the job would never go quiet. Signals that were enriched and promoted before #313 but found no concept are excluded for the same reason.

The pattern and insight counts are what decides whether September (about 9,500 signals) is worth its enrich cost.

## Tests

`test/enrich-backfill.test.mjs`: two new cases (a read signal is not a candidate, nor is a marked one; the yield counts), and the test's own column workaround is gone. Full suite: 1150 pass, 6 fail. The 6 are the report-render tests, which need `pdftoppm`; the workbench lacks it and the box has it.
params.title: The enrich backfill ends: only signals enrich never read, and what it bought
